summary: Detailed implementation plan to fix the missing MCQ section and all website functionality on GitHub-deployed sites. Pre-bundles the complete JAC Class 10 question bank across all subjects (Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Hindi, English, Sanskrit, Urdu, IT, Healthcare), enables client-side offline persistence and evaluation, connects all subject cards and navigation routes, adds standalone /mcq routing, and verifies both server and static GitHub Pages build targets.
